blocks.text: Plantation Bay Resort and Spa, the world-renowned 11-hectare luxury retreat in Mactan, Cebu, has officially unveiled an expanded wellness portfolio, solidifying its position as the undisputed Wellness Capital of the South. Moving far beyond traditional spa treatments, Plantation Bay introduces advanced health technology alongside its serene, village-style architecture—setting a new benchmark for integrative wellness in the Philippines. Next-Generation Health & Healing At the center of Plantation Bay’s upgraded wellness offerings are two cutting-edge therapies designed to restore mind and body: Duo Hyperbaric Oxygen Chamber: Designed comfortably for two guests, this advanced Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT) chamber delivers 100% pure oxygen at […]...
